# The engine's birth and mortality lines on laws, technologies and institutions, moved to script-only types
# (owner, 2026-10-11; docs/superpowers/archive/plans/2026-10-11-demographics-engine-lines-script-only.md): a fixed-sign
# pair per field (P.ENGINE_LINE_FIELDS), re-applied at the two families' sum while te_demog_lines_apply holds.
# A release keeps these files (scripts/release/comment_out_census_inputs.py doesn't read them).
# State scope. te_demog_line_<short>: the families' sum the engine reads; _applied: the pair in force, signed
# (0 with neither held), which te_demog_rates_refresh takes off the state read; _up_mult / _down_mult: the
# multipliers, from the stored sum (te_dg_ln_<short>), ROOT being the state.
te_demog_line_births = {
	value = modifier:state_demog_absorbed_birth_rate_mult
	add = modifier:state_demog_ontop_birth_rate_mult
}
te_demog_line_births_applied = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_up
				has_modifier = te_demog_line_births_down
			}
		}
		value = var:te_dg_ln_births
	}
}
te_demog_line_births_up_mult = {
	value = var:te_dg_ln_births
}
te_demog_line_births_down_mult = {
	value = var:te_dg_ln_births
	multiply = -1
}
